name: agent-session-provenance
description: Check and document Git/Jujutsu Agent-Session provenance in Codex workspaces.

interface.longDescription: Provides Codex guidance for verifying that patched Git/Jujutsu are on PATH and that AGENT_SESSION_ID is present before creating commits. Codex plugins do not currently provide a proven session-start environment mutation hook, so this plugin is a native check/guidance surface rather than a launcher wrapper.
defaultPrompt: Check agent session provenance before committing.
Verify Git and Jujutsu Agent-Session attribution.
